tools.name: quick_check
tools.description: Estimates a website's risk under Google's spam policies from a SAMPLE of about 15 pages (homepage and a few linked pages). Takes 30 to 45 seconds and costs $0.15 from the prepaid balance (the same domain within 24 h is served from cache). The score only covers the pages checked: read coverage.messag

tools.name: start_deep_report
tools.description: Starts a Deep Report: every page of the site (up to maxPages, default and maximum 500) is judged against Google's spam policies, with a prioritised action plan. tools.name: get_deep_report
tools.description: Progress of a Deep Report, then its results once status is done. Free. Set pages to true for the page-by-page verdicts. status waiting_for_search_console means it starts when the owner opens searchConsole.connectUrl.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: The prepaid balance of this API key's account, today's spend and daily cap, and the current prices. Free.
